title: Auto-Features: An LLM-Assisted Corpus for Contextual Recognition of Standard and Optional Car Features
abstract: arXiv:2611.33974v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present Auto-Features, a corpus for detecting a car's standard and optional features in advertisement text, given the feature catalogue of that exact vehicle. Sellers name the same feature in many ways. We therefore cast the task as feature-conditioned, or contextual, named entity recognition: extract the span that expresses one given catalogue feature. An entity-linking view follows from the same output. The corpus has a human-gold layer (430 adverts) from screened annotators and an LLM-silver layer (925 adverts) auto-annotated by a search-grounded LLM. We also contribute the way it was built. Every LLM output is validated, and each kind of failure has its own remedy. Malformed output is patched. Hallucinated content triggers a fresh attempt by a stronger model. Links to features outside the candidate list are dropped and counted (3 in 10,928 records). The LLM annotates alone only after its agreement with human annotators on link ver

translated_title: Auto-Features：一个用于上下文识别汽车标准配置与选装配置的LLM辅助语料库
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Auto-Features，这是一个在给定某确切车辆的功能目录的前提下，用于在广告文本中检测汽车标准配置和选装配置的语料库。由于销售者会用多种不同方式命名同一配置，我们将该任务设定为特征条件化（即上下文化）的命名实体识别：提取表达某一给定目录配置的文本片段。基于相同的输出还可以得到实体链接的视角。该语料库包含一个由经过筛选的标注员构建的人工黄金层（430条广告）和一个由基于搜索的大语言模型自动标注的LLM白银层（925条广告）。我们还贡献了该语料库的构建方法：每一个LLM输出都经过验证，且每种类型的失败都有其对应的补救措施——格式错误的输出会被修补，幻觉内容会触发由更强模型重新尝试，指向候选列表之外配置的链接会被丢弃并计数（10,928条记录中仅有3条）。只有当LLM与人工标注员在链接验证上的一致性达到……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Auto-Features语料库，将汽车配置识别任务建模为特征条件化的命名实体识别，构建了包含人工黄金层与LLM白银层的双层语料库，并提供了一套针对LLM各类标注失败逐一验证与补救的系统化质量控制流程。
